scope: No actual model/result/certificate/teacher word loaded; no scientific imports, graph, policy, search, training, native checking or replay. Synthetic literal matching is advice, not mathematics proved.

syntax_compatibility.ast: JSON tagged arrays correspond to the arithmetic logic.py immutable tagged tuples: var, fun, pred, eq, not, all, and, imp, bot; fun/pred arguments are ordered third-field arrays. No algebraic normalization, equality symmetry or conjunction reordering.
syntax_compatibility.prefix_slots: Only distinctly named leading universally bound variables become pattern slots. Bound-slot renaming can preserve matching behavior; no general alpha-equivalence rewriting claimed.
syntax_compatibility.constants: Completed instantiation constants stay rigid. Slot images restricted to closed zero-arity functions. Literal compound constructors recurse, so \(\operatorname{add}(x,0)=x\) against the corresponding constant instance is supported, while binding \(x\) to \(\operatorname{succ}(0)\) remains neutral.
syntax_compatibility.unsupported: Nested quantification, shadowed/repeated prefix binders, free pattern variables outside that prefix and unsupported constructors are neutral advice, never logical rejection.
syntax_compatibility.old_match_not_reused: logic.match() treats every variable as a substitution slot and allows arbitrary term images. It is not the prospective prefix-scoped receptor matcher; no import/reuse performed.

available_formula_scope.geometry: The frozen geometry design uses outputs of physically selected primitive placements as structural formula constraints. A selected MP output may depend on pending earlier-source receptors; it is not an established hypothesis or proved fact. This assessment imposes no new geometry completion/pruning rule.
available_formula_scope.marks: An assigned formula mark on an unoccupied row does not make a selected output available. Assigned zero is still an assigned value; absence is not zero.
available_formula_scope.arithmetic: Arithmetic has separate C/G/I1/I2 placements. A future completed-output adapter needs all four roles, agreeing command/guard/inference/mode, correct ordered strict-prior source references/formulas, explicit unused inputs and completed dependencies. commutativity13_guidance.requirements()/vectors() provides source evidence for that distinction; synthetic Boolean agreement flags are declarative, not an actual engine certification.
available_formula_scope.identities: Keep duplicate formula outputs on distinct rows and ordered references distinct. Matching advice may be Boolean but cannot merge primitive identities, fallbacks or incidence domains.

activation_gap.current_arithmetic: The currently searched contextual arithmetic grammar creates block/refl/generalize rules. primitive_stream() declares instantiate/distribute/schema instances but explicitly does not search them. Therefore an instantiate/MP-specific quantifier guidance feature does not automatically activate on the current arithmetic model.
activation_gap.future_adapter: A primitive arithmetic control or an explicitly designed interface receptor adapter would need its own complete model/source/authority freeze and independent graph/fallback/scheduler/rollback gates. This memo does not implement or authorize that change.
activation_gap.scope_of_cross_domain_fixture: Synthetic arithmetic/FOL AST agreement tests portable syntax only; they are not evidence of practical arithmetic search acceleration or held-out theorem transfer.

ranking_safety.statuses: Gold corpus calls literal mismatch miss; Hilbert prospective API names it nonmatch. Both mean ordering advice only. Match, neutral and nonmatch must never remove a legal candidate.
ranking_safety.requirements: Retain original readiness tiers, the complete permutation, global dead/forced/earliest-generation graph decision, original tie order, full fallback and exact rollback. No theorem/predicate/constant IDs in matcher algorithms.
ranking_safety.rl: This is an authored deterministic feature; no RL training, learned marking or proof discovery is inferred.

positive_certificate_reader_interface_ga: Reader-v4 expects one decorated primitive square per proof row with key [recipeIndex,row,orderedSourceRows], geometry t/m points and recipe witness metadata. Arithmetic C/G/I1/I2 placements have four-integer keys and four physical squares per inference row; they cannot be passed directly to that reader without a separately frozen exact rendering adapter.

Reader-v4 ruleEnglish gives generic saved-rule explanations for assumption/instantiate/eq_subst, with the exact command inspectable. A positive certificate could benefit from explaining the actual hypothesis index, instantiation term/universal and equality-substitution template in English. No display change was made.

Reader independent_certificate_accepted is an explicit root flag; independent_scope must state whether acceptance is symbolic, native or both. The reader must never infer native checking from a found point certificate.
producer_api_pending: Hilbert supplied prospective extract_pattern, literal_guard_match, evaluate_pattern and ReceptorOrder API; source file not yet available/frozen at corpus authoring. Actual producer compatibility execution remains unexecuted.
authoring_cost: Source authoring elapsed/CPU uninstrumented; bounded independent synthetic helper cost will be measured separately. No old research budget reset or new scientific cost.
